title: Models stronger than Fable get export-restricted -> user-given target: Inspect

input.event: Models more capable than Fable become subject to US export restrictions
input.target_note: Target B is given by the user in the demo; NVDA is a placeholder the main session can change

expected.behavior: Give an A -> B causal path (branching and merging allowed) or no_chain with a reason. At least one document or event condition (the formal export-control filing, effective date, licence requirement); anchor and deadline are absolute dates or a user-specified scenario start. No invented numeric thresholds. Every plan's gate is WAIT.
expected.key_excerpts_note: Model-weight controls: sc-044 (AI Diffusion rule, ECCN 4E091), sc-045 (not enforced), sc-046 (GAO: not formally rescinded), sc-047 (draft global licensing rule withdrawn); NVDA side: sc-050 (H20 licence and $5.5B charge), sc-051 (no H200 revenue yet). Gap: the pack has no excerpt linking model-weight controls to NVDA revenue and no replacement rule; the chip-control excerpts sc-029-032, sc-048, sc-049 govern chips, not model weights, so they are not key excerpts. A reasonable output is no_chain or marking that hop model_only.

human_review: E1: is every hop of the path grounded in the pack
E2: are the document / event conditions specific, decidable and logically tied to the thesis
notes: Online is controlled by the runner's --online flag; evidence_packs no longer lists 'web' (the old placeholder name, which made the runner report a missing pack). The offline run belongs to layer A; the online run belongs to layer W, recorded once and then replayed, reporting round-1 / round-2 model_only edge counts and null-threshold condition counts. Wording: the repo has no copy of the original assignment text, so this English phrasing is ours, not the assignment's verbatim wording. Replace it with the assignment's exact sentence when available.
